question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'development.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence "***It is a national program designed to facilitate investment, foster innovation, enhance skill ___4___​...***'' is indicating to **enhance something related to skill**.
 
• The use of the word ''enhance'' in the sentence indicates **to improve something or to make something look better**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'development'.
